{{Top|leg}}
'''D.M. Skecher''' was an individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was said that [[The Hilltop]] structure on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] looked similar to his work.<ref name="SWG:PVT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', players can complete a collection called "Panoramic Vistas." In this collection, players were given a clue as to how to find a place called "The Hilltop," stating that it looked similar to the work of D.M. Skecher.<ref name="SWG:PVT" />

The name D.M. Skecher is probably a tongue-in-cheek reference to the real life [[Wikipedia:M.C. Escher|M.C. Escher]].
